items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I worked at Redd Foxx's Club.

ctx.x: Was that the second tour to Australia?
The third tour. And then I did some- things and then I worked at Redd Foxx's Club. And when I closed there I went back to Shelley, and that's when I learned that my mother was sick.
And you went back to Louisville?
